# Descent TCG

> Descent TCG is a collector-run trading card shop at 5205 33rd St E, Bradenton, FL 34203.
> It buys and sells rare and vintage trading cards — Pokémon, Disney Lorcana, Magic: The
> Gathering, and One Piece — including raw singles, professionally graded slabs, and sealed
> product (booster boxes, cases, Elite Trainer Boxes).
> Contact: matthew@descenttcg.com (typical response within 24–48 hours).
> Full retail inventory is hosted on the shop's TCGplayer Pro storefront: https://dig.tcgplayerpro.com/

## Key pages

- [Home](https://descenttcg.com/): Overview of the shop and how buying works.
- [Our Store](https://descenttcg.com/our-store): Physical shop details (address, contact) and link to the full online inventory.
- [Lorcana Vault](https://descenttcg.com/lorcana-vault): Disney Lorcana chase cards and sealed product with prices; offers accepted on every item.
- [TCG Vault](https://descenttcg.com/sealed-vault): Sealed TCG product, including booster boxes, vintage packs, premium collections, regional exclusives, Magic: The Gathering TMNT product, and the Team Boss Pikachu (JP) collection.
- [Fort Knox Vault](https://descenttcg.com/fort-knox-vault): Live sealed inventory via Collectr.
- [About](https://descenttcg.com/about): The shop's story — collector-run since the late 1990s.
- [Contact](https://descenttcg.com/contact): Inquiries, valuations, and offers.
